about: What a multisig member is and how it signs — one rule over facts (multisig_signers), every machine's: signer_kind (kindOf), kind_evidence (evidence), kind_choice (kindChoice), plain_accounts (plainAccounts). Ported from signers.test.ts and member-kind.test.ts, with the owner's rule (2026-10-30): a Vela account when Vela's shared passkey signer is configured for it (getConfiguration non-empty: `configured`), or the index / this device / a counted passkey approval says so; any other contract code a smart contract account; a read that failed decides nothing. Facts: local, approvedWith (passkey|wallet), indexed, indexAnswered, kept (passkey|wallet|contract), code (true|false|null: unread), configured (true|false|null: unread or a read failed).

signerKind.name: this device's account signs here
the passkey index knows it: a Vela account
nothing read yet: nothing offered on a guess
code at its address, its signer configuration unread: no verdict (code alone is no Vela account)
code at its address, the index answered none, the configuration unread: still no verdict (a read that failed decides nothing)
code, and the chain says Vela's signer is not configured for it: a smart contract account
Vela's signer configured for it: a Vela account, with no index record
configured on another chain, nothing here yet: a Vela account
no code, the index not answered, the configuration unread: still unknown
approved anything with her passkey: a Vela account, before the code read too
kept here as a Vela account: a Vela account
kept as a Vela account with code: stands until the chain answers its signer is not configured
kept as a Vela account with code and no configuration: a smart contract account (evidence beats the label)
kept as an outside wallet, but code there without Vela's signer: a smart contract account
kept as a smart contract account (an invite's c): one, before any code is read
kept as an outside wallet, but it approved with its passkey: a Vela account
kept as a smart contract account, but Vela's signer is configured for it: a Vela account
nothing says, no code, the index holds none: unsure
nothing says, no code, Vela's signer configured nowhere read: unsure
a wallet's own signature, with no code: a plain wallet
kept as an outside wallet, with no code: a plain wallet

evidence.name: an account here: a Vela account
one the passkey index holds: a Vela account
Vela's signer configured for it, no index record: a Vela account
a counted passkey approval: a Vela account
another Safe as a member: code, Vela's signer not configured — a smart contract account
code, its configuration read failed: it can't tell — asked
no code anywhere and Vela's signer configured nowhere: likely an outside wallet
no code anywhere and the index holds none: likely an outside wallet
a network that does not answer: it can't tell — asked
no code, nothing answered for Vela's signer: asked
kept as a smart contract account is a label, not evidence

kindChoice.name: a Vela account found: shown as found, not asked
a Vela account found: evidence beats the label
a smart contract account, shown, never 'Vela account'
a smart contract account: evidence beats the label (Vela account said)
a smart contract account: evidence beats the label (outside wallet said)
an invite's c, nothing read yet: the label stands
the person's word stands where the wallet has no finding
the person's word over the 'Other wallet' hint
the person's word, the same as the hint
no Vela account found: 'Other wallet' only hinted — nothing kept unless picked
it can't tell: nothing picked — the person is asked

plainAccounts.name: only plain accounts: never this device's, a deployed smart account, a Vela account, a passkey approver or a kept Vela or contract account
